description: This PHP file defines the class TemplateDatetimecombo, which extends the TemplateRange class to implement a datetime combo field in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes properties for time strings, date calculation options, and methods for default database value, field definition, and populating data from POST requests.

classes.name: TemplateDatetimecombo
classes.description: A class representing a datetime combo field type in SuiteCRM, with properties for date and time options and methods to handle default values and data population from user input.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object, setting up date strings and inheriting from TemplateRange.

methods.name: get_db_default
methods.description: Returns the default database value for the field, which is an empty string.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Returns the field definition array with database type set to 'datetime' and handles default value settings.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates the object properties from POST request data, handling date and time parsing, and cleaning input data.
